title: Flaky timing tests fail under load: tofu_capacity hold_down, edhoc_transport handshake, edhoc_responder deadline
description: P2 flakiness (edhoc only — the tofu_capacity hold_down case was reclassified as a deterministic failure owned by hg27): python/tests/coap/test_edhoc_transport.py::test_edhoc_handshake_via_coap and 3 TestEdhocResource tests in python/tests/coap/test_edhoc_responder.py (completed_m3_can_publish_after_deadline, completing_session_holds_capacity_until_finalized, close_during_completion_cancels_publication_without_success) failed one full-suite run, passed the next (wall-clock deadline dependence under parallel load). Fix by injecting a fake clock / relaxing wall-clock deadlines rather than raising timeouts blindly.
